newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison to book HK$1.24 bln gain.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison to book HK$1.24 bln gain.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Ltd said on Tuesday it would book an exceptional profit of HK$1.24 billion from the disposal of its stake in Hongkong Electric Holdings Ltd to Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd.

In the same joint statement, Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said the estimated surplus on the transfer of its stake in Cheung Kong Infrastructure to Hutchison and the 1996 flotation of Cheung Kong Infrastructure amounted to HK$9.63 billion.
Hutchison said the exceptional gain came from the disposal of its effective 5.4 percent stake in Hongkong Electric resulting from a reorganisation of the Cheung Kong group in January.

In the reorganisation, Hutchison lifted its stake in Hongkong Electric to 35.01 percent and said it would transfer the entire stake to Cheung Kong Infrastructure (CKI) in return for 886.21 million new CKI shares.

In the deal, Cheung Kong would also transfer its existing 70.66 percent shareholding in CKI Holdings to Hutchison for about HK$20.45 billion to be satisfied by 254.32 million new Hutchison shares and about HK$5.57 billion in cash.

Under the reshuffle, Hutchison would hold 84.6 percent of CKI, reducing its effective stake in Hongkong Electric by 5.40 percent. Hutchison said 15.2 percent of CKI's issued share capital would remain in public hands after the reorganisation.
